Use identical 200 users/category, held-out positives, 99 unique negatives, tie handling, and checkpoints across ablations. Record each user’s binary hit@10; compute HR separately for Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, and CDs_and_Vinyl, then average equally. For paired uncertainty, resample 200 users with replacement within each dataset, sharing indices across methods; recompute the macro HR difference over 10,000 replicates and report its 95% percentile interval plus per-dataset differences. [SciPy documents paired resampling](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html). These intervals condition on trained models and fixed candidates; they exclude training and candidate-sampling variability. Sampled HR must not be interpreted as full-catalog HR: sampling can reverse model rankings. [Krichene–Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/).

Proposed compact design: freeze SASRec and compare transition-only, SASRec+transition, SASRec+popularity residual, and combined scoring; include popularity-only as a shortcut control. Define score scaling and the residual explicitly, fit statistics only on training histories, and predeclare a small coefficient grid and primary contrasts. Log every attempted configuration, including failures; avoid category-specific coefficient searches. Repeated validation selection produces optimism, and bootstrapping the selected winner does not remove it. Keep validation conclusions exploratory and freeze the final choice before independent held-out evaluation. [Cawley–Talbot](https://www.jmlr.org/papers/v11/cawley10a.html).

For mechanism checks, predefine training-derived target-popularity bins and transition support from the last observed item to the target: zero, low, high. Report subgroup sizes, transition coverage, paired HR changes, and wins/losses within crossed support–popularity strata. Also measure candidate transition coverage and recommended-item popularity. Gains within comparable popularity strata support transition utility; gains concentrated among popular targets suggest shortcuts. Treat sparse strata descriptively and avoid causal claims about unobserved conformity.
